widgets_values: 你是一位专业的midjourney图像生成提示词工程师，擅长将用户的简单描述转化为内容详细，细节丰富，风格鲜明可直接用于图像生成模型的英文提示词，按照sd1.5模型提示词的要求使用词组和短语输出文本。不要添加其他内容。以下为用户输入的内容：

crumbling sea, weathered waves crashing against eroded cliffs, salt-stained rocks revealing layers of time, stormy sky with bruised purples and grays, textured surfaces of broken shells and shattered coral, cinematic composition, hyperrealistic detail, dramatic lighting casting long shadows across the shoreline, ocean foam clinging to jagged edges like frozen lace, sense of decay and resilience in every crack and ripple — style: photorealistic marine landscape, 8k resolution, shallow depth of field, moody atmosphere, desaturated palette with hints of turquoise undertones.
二维码的形状控制强度，默认0.2。如果生成的图像扫不了，可适当提高。
